title: SaxaVord Scrapped Launch Rail Plans, Forcing HyImpulse to Bring Its Own
summary:
UK-based launch facility SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it abandoned plans to develop a shared suborbital launch rail, with German rocket builder HyImpulse now preparing to bring its own system to the Scottish launch site for the second flight of its SR75 rocket.
